Runs the Jest suite of every module workspace — shared,

UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

perWorkerGb

Total jest-worker budget this machine affords — identical formula to shared/tests/jest.preset.mjs workerBudget(): ~2GiB per plain worker, ~3GiB under istanbul instrumentation, capped by cores−1. Splitting the SAME total across concurrent module runs keeps the aggregate heap under the reclaim ceiling instead of multiplying it by the pool size.

MODULE_JOBS

Module-run concurrency: the largest pool where every suite still gets ≥3 workers (below that, per-worker spawn cost outweighs parallelism). TEST_MODULE_JOBS overrides; 1 restores the old strictly-serial shape.

workersEach

Jest workers granted to each concurrent suite.

runModule

Runs one module's jest suite with piped stdio — output is buffered and replayed under the module banner on exit so concurrent suites never interleave report lines.

  • @param {string} name module name (banner + failure list)
  • @param {string} config jest.config.mjs path relative to root
  • @returns {Promise} resolves true when the suite passed

cursor

Bounded worker-drain over the selected modules — each slot pulls the next suite until the list is exhausted. Iterative drain, not recursion: the tasks are a flat list, not a self-similar structure.
